It correctly presents the remaining gap as price/risk justification rather than a missing decorative feature.

recommended_balance.qualification: Canisius presentation is titled Americas Competition, but it is the exact presentation archived by CFA under global champions. Dated global-award release verifies the same team and Sovran subject. Do not claim an independently verified live-final file hash.
